en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings. The central structure is a large early‑20th‑century commercial or office block with arched windows on the top floor and several shopfronts at street level, above which faint signage is visible. People in period clothing walk along the sidewalk. To the right stands an older, more ornate building with pilasters and tall windows; behind the street a large stone church or monastery complex with steep rooflines is visible. The image has the framing, tone, and paper border typical of historical postcards.
